views.title: Pretraining loss
views.label: Pretraining loss $\mathcal{L}_{diag} + \mathcal{L}_{off}$
views.shows: $\mathcal{L} = \mathcal{L}_{diag} + \mathcal{L}_{off}$ on the training batch (nats per token)

views.title: Diagonal loss
views.label: Diagonal cross-entropy
views.shows: $\mathcal{L}_{diag} = -\frac{1}{L}\sum_l x_1^l \cdot \log \hat\delta_{t,t}(I_t)^l$ (nats per token)

views.title: Semigroup loss
views.label: Semigroup cross-entropy
views.shows: $\mathcal{L}_{off} = -\frac{1}{L}\sum_l \bar\delta^l \cdot \log \hat\delta_{s,t}(I_s)^l$ (nats per token; includes the entropy of $\bar\delta$, so its floor is not 0)

views.title: Well-formed, 1 jump
views.label: Well-formed equations, $K = 1$
views.shows: fraction of 2000 argmax samples $y = \arg\max X_{0,1}(z)$ that parse as $ab+cd=efg$

views.title: Correct, 1 jump (pretraining)
views.label: Correct equations, $K = 1$
views.shows: fraction of 2000 argmax samples with $K = 1$ that are correct ($a + b = c$); data has $\frac{1}{2}$

views.title: Correct, 4 jumps (pretraining)
views.label: Correct equations, $K = 4$
views.shows: fraction of 2000 argmax samples with $K = 4$ that are correct

views.title: Reward, sampled
views.label: Correct, sampled at $T$
views.shows: $\frac{1}{1000}\sum_n R(y_n)$, $y_n \sim \pi_\theta(\cdot \mid z_n)$, fixed $z_n$

views.title: Reward, argmax
views.label: Correct, argmax decoding
views.shows: $\frac{1}{1000}\sum_n R(\arg\max \ell_\theta(z_n))$, fixed $z_n$

views.title: Distinct correct
views.label: Distinct correct equations (of 1000)
views.shows: number of distinct correct strings among the 1000 sampled $y_n$ (diversity)

views.title: Policy entropy
views.label: Token entropy $H(p_{\theta,i})$
views.shows: $\frac{1}{L}\sum_i H(p_{\theta,i}(\cdot \mid z))$ averaged over the 1000 evaluation noises (nats)

views.title: KL to pretrained
views.label: KL to pretrained policy
views.shows: $\mathbb{E}_z \sum_i KL(p_{\theta,i}(\cdot\mid z) \Vert p_{ref,i}(\cdot\mid z))$ over the 1000 evaluation noises (nats per sequence)

views.title: Training reward
views.label: Correct, training batch
views.shows: $\frac{1}{BG}\sum_{b,g} r_{b,g}$ on the rollout batch

views.title: Held-out correct, 1 jump (pretraining)
views.label: Correct on held-out pairs, $K = 1$
views.shows: among argmax samples ($K = 1$) whose operands $(a,b)$ were held out of pretraining, fraction with $a + b = c$

views.title: Held-out correct, sampled
views.label: Correct on held-out pairs, sampled
views.shows: among the 1000 sampled $y_n$ whose operands were held out of pretraining, fraction with $a + b = c$

views.title: Correct answers, training questions, 1 jump
views.label: Correct, train questions, $K = 1$
views.shows: fraction of 1000 training questions $c$ whose argmax answer ($K = 1$) is $a + b$

views.title: Correct answers, held-out questions, 1 jump
views.label: Correct, held-out questions, $K = 1$
views.shows: fraction of 1000 held-out questions (never in training) whose argmax answer ($K = 1$) is $a + b$

views.title: Correct answers, held-out questions, 8 jumps
views.label: Correct, held-out questions, $K = 8$
views.shows: same with $K = 8$ jumps

views.title: Correct answers (RL), held-out questions, argmax
views.label: Correct, held-out questions, argmax
views.shows: fraction of 1000 held-out questions whose argmax answer is correct (RL evaluation)

views.title: Answer digits right, held-out questions, 1 jump
views.label: Digit accuracy, held-out, $K = 1$
views.shows: fraction of the $n + 1$ answer digits equal to the digits of $a + b$, over 1000 held-out questions, argmax, $K = 1$

views.title: Answer digits right (RL), held-out questions
views.label: Digit accuracy, held-out, sampled

views.title: Correct answers (RL), held-out questions, zero noise
views.label: Correct, held-out questions, $z = 0$

algos.flowmap-pg: $\mathcal{L}(\theta) = -\frac{1}{GL}\sum_{g,i} \min(\rho_{g,i} A_g, \mathrm{clip}(\rho_{g,i}) A_g) + \beta KL$, $\rho_{g,i} = p_{\theta,i}(y_{g,i}\mid z_g)/p_{old,i}(y_{g,i}\mid z_g)$
algos.flowmap-sft: $\mathcal{L}_{sft} = -\frac{1}{N L_a}\sum_{n,i} \log p_{\theta,i}(y^*_{n,i} \mid z_n, c_n)$: the true answer as target of the RL policy, same budget as RL
algos.ar-ce: autoregressive baseline: $\mathcal{L}_{ar} = -\frac{1}{B L_a}\sum_{b,i} \log \mathrm{softmax}(f_\theta(c_b, y_{b,<i})_i)(y_{b,i})$, causal transformer of the same size
algos.ar-pg: autoregressive baseline RL: $\mathcal{L}_{pg} = -\frac{1}{G L_a}\sum_{g,i} sg(A_g) \log \pi_\theta(y_{g,i} \mid c, y_{g,<i})$, same advantages and rewards as flowmap-pg

params.init: checkpoint to start from: the RL or fine-tuned policy, or resumed pretraining (weights and EMA)
params.task.name: dataset: arithmetic (equations of digits) or countdown (4 numbers and a target; answer = postfix expression using each number once, reward 1 if it equals the target)
params.task.n_digits: $n$: digits per operand; the answer has $n + 1$ digits
params.task.frac_correct: $q$: fraction of pretraining equations with the right sum
params.train.batch_size: $B$: pretraining batch size (half diagonal, half semigroup)
params.train.ema: decay of the EMA of the weights
params.reward: exact: $r = \mathbb{1}[y = y^*(c)]$; digits: $r = \frac{1}{L_a}\sum_i \mathbb{1}[y_i = y^*_i(c)]$, $y^*(c)$ true answer; per_digit: $r_i = \mathbb{1}[y_i = y^*_i(c)]$, one advantage per digit
params.rl.K: $K$: number of jumps of the policy
params.rl.option: A: logits of the last jump $t_{K-1} \to 1$; B: diagonal logits at $t^* = t(\tau^*)$
params.rl.tau_star: $\tau^*$: stopping time of option B, in $\tau$
params.rl.advantage: loo: $A_g = r_g - \frac{1}{G-1}\sum_{j\ne g} r_j$; std: $A_g = (r_g - \bar r)/(s_r + 10^{-6})$
params.rl.stochastic: every jump samples tokens: $x_{k+1} = \frac{1-t_{k+1}}{1-t_k} x_k + \frac{t_{k+1}-t_k}{1-t_k} \mathrm{onehot}(\hat y_k)$, $\hat y_k \sim \mathrm{Cat}(\mathrm{softmax}(\ell_{t_k,t_{k+1}}(x_k)/T))$; the policy is the chain of $K$ categoricals
params.rl.rwr: $\lambda$: weight of $\mathcal{L}_{rwr}$, the final answer $y$ as target of $\mathrm{softmax}(\ell_{t_k,1}(x_k)/T)$ for $k < K-1$, weighted by $A$
params.rl.entropy: $\alpha$: weight of the entropy bonus $-\alpha \frac{1}{GL}\sum_{g,i} H(p_{\theta,i})$, $H(p) = -\sum_v p_v \log p_v$; pushes the policy to spread its probability and explore
params.rl.micro: number of equal slices of the $N = BG$ samples of a step; the step uses $\nabla_\theta \sum_{m} \frac{1}{M} \mathcal{L}(\text{slice } m)$, $M$ = `rl.micro`, the same gradient as the whole batch with $1/M$ of the memory
params.sft: true: supervised fine-tuning $\mathcal{L}_{sft}$ on the true answers instead of RL (algorithm flowmap-sft)
params.mode: autoregressive baseline: pretrain ($\mathcal{L}_{ar}$ from scratch or resumed), sft ($\mathcal{L}_{ar}$ on the task pairs from a checkpoint) or rl ($\mathcal{L}_{pg}$)
params.rl.beta: $\beta$: weight of the KL to the pretrained policy
params.track.title: tracker title
params.track.question: tracker question
params.task.holdout_frac: fraction of operand pairs $(a,b)$ never shown in pretraining (with any sum)
params.task.max_num: Countdown: the four numbers are drawn uniformly in $\{1, \dots, \text{max\_num}\}$
params.task.max_target: Countdown: targets $v$ of the generating expression are kept when $1 \le v \le \text{max\_target}$
params.cond.mode: none: unconditional; state: question as clean one-hot rows $\mathrm{onehot}(c)E$; encoder: question read by a separate encoder
params.allow_no_holdout: debugging only: allow a run without a held-out set
params.task.op: operation: add ($c = a + b$, $n + 1$ answer digits) or mul ($c = a \times b$, $2n$ answer digits)
params.task.n_train: Sudoku: number of solved grids in the training pool (seeds $0, \dots, n-1$)
params.task.n_heldout: Sudoku: number of held-out solved grids (separate seeds, never trained on)
params.task.min_blanks: Sudoku: blanks per puzzle $b \sim \mathcal{U}\{b_{min}, \dots, \min(b_{max}, |R|)\}$, $b_{min}$ = this, $R$ = cells that can be blanked with a unique solution
params.keep_ckpts: save a checkpoint every `train.ckpt_every` steps (default: every evaluation), to start RL from a chosen accuracy
params.train.ckpt_every: steps between two checkpoints kept by `keep_ckpts`
params.resume: true: the run goes on from the step stored in `init` (same step numbers, new optimizer with its warmup)
params.rl.zs: $s$: noise scale of the RL rollouts, $z \sim \mathcal{N}(0, s^2 I)$; $s = 1$ is the pretraining noise, $s = 0$ the mode-seeking decoding
params.train_min_blanks: Sudoku, training draws only: blanks $b \sim \mathcal{U}\{b_{train}, \dots, \min(b_{max}, |R|)\}$ with $b_{train}$ = `train_min_blanks`; evaluation keeps all puzzles

symbols.\\hat\\delta_{s,t}: two-time denoiser, softmax output of the network
symbols.P_e: probability that $\arg\max$ of a row of $I_t$ is not the data token
symbols.R: reward, 1 if the equation is correct
